status_note: active; v9.6.2 monorepo (13 packages), React 19 peer, Node >=22, very high release cadence
core_problem: A full React component library (161 core components + 87 hooks) whose single JS theme object is compiled into a stable set of CSS custom properties, so every component is styled by plain CSS modules that only read variables, and theming/dark mode/scaling never require CSS-in-JS at runtime.
architecture: Data model: `MantineTheme` (packages/@mantine/core/src/core/MantineProvider/theme.types.ts) is a typed object of scalar tokens (fontSizes/spacing/radius/shadows/lineHeights/fontWeights/breakpoints as xs..xl records, headings.sizes h1..h6, colors as 10-shade tuples, `primaryColor`, `primaryShade: number | {light,dark}`, `scale`, `autoContrast`, `luminanceThreshold`, `variantColorResolver`, `components` (per-component classNames/styles/vars/defaultProps overrides) and an untyped `other` bag). `createTheme` is an identity function used purely for typing; `mergeMantineTheme` deep-merges the override onto DEFAULT_THEME and `validateMantineTheme` throws on an invalid primaryColor/primaryShade. Token -> CSS-var compilation is a pure function: `defaultCssVariablesResolver(theme)` (MantineCssVariables/default-css-variables-resolver.ts) returns `{variables, light, dark}` maps; `getCSSColorVariables` derives, per color and per scheme, the 10 raw shade vars plus semantic aliases (`--mantine-color-X-filled`, `-filled-hover`, `-light`, `-light-hover`, `-light-color`, `-outline`, `-outline-hover`, `-text`) from `primaryShade`; `convertCssVariables` serializes to `:root, :host{...}` and `:root[data-mantine-color-scheme=dark|light]{...}` strings. It runs at BOTH build time and runtime: scripts/codegen/generate-default-css-variables.ts writes `default-css-variables.css` (27 kB raw / 3.9 kB gz) which MantineProvider imports statically, and at runtime `<MantineCssVariables>` runs the resolver on the merged theme, diffs against the default output (`removeDefaultVariables`, `deduplicateCssVariables=true`) and injects only the delta in a `<style data-mantine-styles>` tag. The `cssVariablesResolver` provider prop is a user function `(theme) => {variables, light, dark}` deep-merged over the default output, i.e. an extension point to add project-specific vars. Colour scheme: `ColorSchemeScript` emits an inline pre-paint script that reads localStorage and sets `data-mantine-color-scheme` on `<html>`; `useProviderColorScheme` keeps it in sync with `matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')`. Virtual colors (`virtualColor({name, light, dark})`) are tuples of `var(--mantine-color-name-i)` with hidden props, so one token name resolves to different palettes per scheme. `luminance.ts` computes WCAG relative luminance (gamma-corrected sRGB, oklch fast path) and `isLightColor(color, luminanceThreshold)` drives `getContrastColor`/`autoContrast` to pick black or white text for filled variants; `defaultVariantColorsResolver` maps (variant x color) -> {background, hover, color, border} and is replaceable via `theme.variantColorResolver`. Component layer: `Box` (core/Box/Box.tsx) is the polymorphic base; `extractStyleProps`/`parseStyleProps` turn shorthand props (m, p, bg, c, fz, w, pos...) into inline styles via typed resolvers (spacing/color/fontSize/radius...), and responsive object values into a hashed class + runtime `<InlineStyles>` tag with `(min-width: theme.breakpoints[bp])` media queries. Each component declares a `createVarsResolver<Factory>((theme, props, ctx) => ({root: {'--button-bg': ...}}))` (Button.tsx) whose output is set as inline CSS variables on the root; `Button.module.css` consumes them with fallbacks (`background: var(--button-bg, var(--mantine-primary-color-filled))`) and encodes size scales as CSS vars (`--button-height-xs..xl`), modifiers as `data-*` attributes (`mod` prop -> `getBoxMod`) and all selectors wrapped in `:where()` for zero specificity. `useStyles` (styles-api/use-styles) merges static classes (`mantine-Button-root`, `classNamesPrefix`), CSS-module classes, per-instance `classNames/styles/vars`, and `theme.components[name]` overrides; `unstyled` and `HeadlessMantineProvider` disable the styles. `rem()` (utils/units-converters/rem.ts) emits `calc(Xrem * var(--mantine-scale))` and `postcss-preset-mantine` with `autoRem` rewrites px in CSS modules to that form at build time. CSS distribution (scripts/build/generate-css.ts): each `*.module.css` is compiled to `styles/<Component>.css` and `styles/<Component>.layer.css` (`@layer mantine {...}`), plus the bundle `styles.css` (277 kB raw / 39 kB gz); three globals (`baseline.css`, `default-css-variables.css`, `global.css`) are mandatory and per-component files must be imported in dependency order (UnstyledButton before Button). No AI wiring anywhere. Dependencies of @mantine/core: @floating-ui/react, clsx, react-number-format, react-remove-scroll, type-fest; peer @mantine/hooks + react/react-dom ^19.2. Bundlephobia for the whole barrel: 552 kB min / 162 kB gz (`sideEffects: ['*.css']` so ESM tree-shakes per component). @mantine/hooks: 87 hooks, zero runtime deps, `sideEffects: false`.
core_innovation: A typed theme object compiled by one pure resolver into a namespaced CSS-custom-property contract, emitted at build time for defaults and as a runtime diff for overrides, with per-component vars resolvers so components are styled by static CSS that only reads variables.
strengths: Theme -> CSS-var compilation is a pure, testable function (`defaultCssVariablesResolver` -> `convertCssVariables`) with a snapshot test; the same function powers build-time codegen (`generate-default-css-variables.ts`) and runtime delta injection (`removeDefaultVariables`).

Semantic colour aliases are derived, not authored: from a 10-shade tuple + `primaryShade {light, dark}` it emits `-filled/-filled-hover/-light/-light-hover/-outline/-text` per scheme, so a design system author only supplies palettes and one shade index.
`autoContrast` + `luminanceThreshold` compute foreground (black/white) from WCAG relative luminance (`luminance.ts`, oklch aware) at compile time of the vars, giving deterministic contrast decisions.
Virtual colours (`virtualColor`) let one token name resolve to different palettes in light/dark without touching consumers.
`scale` token + `rem()` = `calc(Xrem * var(--mantine-scale))` + PostCSS `autoRem` gives global proportional scaling from a single variable.

Component CSS discipline worth copying: `:where()` zero-specificity selectors, `data-*` modifier attributes, size scales expressed as CSS vars, instance overrides via inline CSS vars with `var(--x, fallback)`; components remain plain CSS modules with no runtime style generation for the non-responsive path.
`ColorSchemeScript` pre-paint inline script + `data-mantine-color-scheme` attribute is the correct FOUC-free dark-mode pattern and is framework-free.
CSS ships per component (`styles/Button.css`, 8 kB raw / 1.6 kB gz) and as `@layer mantine` variants, so cascade order against host CSS is controllable.

@mantine/hooks is dependency-free; `use-media-query`, `use-in-viewport`, `use-intersection`, `use-reduced-motion` are thin wrappers over matchMedia/IntersectionObserver; `use-focus-trap` (with `tabbable.ts`/`scope-tab.ts`) and `use-scroll-into-view` (rAF easing, reduced-motion aware, cancel on user scroll) contain reusable browser logic.
MIT, 31.7k stars, single dominant maintainer but extremely active (pushed the day before analysis), strong typing (`MantineThemeSizesOverride`/`MantineThemeColorsOverride` module augmentation).
weaknesses: Hard React 19 dependency: every component needs `MantineProvider` context (theme, colour scheme, classNamesPrefix) so any Astro island using a Mantine component pulls React runtime (~45 kB gz) + provider + `@floating-ui/react` + `react-remove-scroll`; incompatible with our 180 kB total JS budget and near-zero-JS islands.

Global CSS is mandatory: `baseline.css` + `default-css-variables.css` + `global.css` before any component CSS; full `styles.css` is 277 kB raw / 39 kB gz and per-component imports must be hand-ordered by dependency (docs page css-files-list.mdx).

Runtime style generation still exists: responsive style props (`{base, sm, md}`) create a random/hashed class and a `<style>` tag per Box (`InlineStyles`), and the theme delta is injected via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` at runtime; not SSG-static by default.

`isLightColor` returns false for any `var(...)` value, so autoContrast silently yields white text whenever a colour is expressed as a CSS variable; the contrast decision is luminance-thresholded (0.3), not a WCAG ratio, so it does not guarantee AA.

Design language is a generic app/dashboard aesthetic (system fonts, blue primary, xs..xl scales); zero support for editorial/marketing `visual_dna` (type scales, rhythm, art direction) -> would fight our design-system-as-token-file model.
Theme is untyped where it matters for us: `other: Record<string, any>`, `components.*: any`; no schema validation beyond primaryColor/primaryShade (`validateMantineTheme`).
`createTheme` is an identity function; there is no serialisable token format (DTCG/JSON) - the theme is JS with functions (`variantColorResolver`), so it cannot be a data file selected by id.

Breakpoints are consumed by JS (`parseStyleProps` builds media queries from `theme.breakpoints`) and by PostCSS (`postcss-simple-vars` duplicates them in postcss.config.cjs), so the same tokens live in two places.

Monorepo is 340 MB with docs apps; upgrade churn is high (v7 -> v8 -> v9 in ~2 years with breaking style API changes), and CSS class hashing (`hash-css-selector`) makes visual-editor targeting brittle.
patterns_to_steal: Pure `theme -> {variables, light, dark}` resolver + `convertCssVariables` serializer -> our design_system stage: `compileTokens(designSystem.json) -> tokens.css` emitted at build time by Astro integration, snapshot-tested per design_system_id, with `[data-color-scheme]` selector scoping.

Build-time default + runtime delta (`removeDefaultVariables`) -> our renderer: emit base `tokens.css` per design system once; page-level overrides (e.g. section-scoped accent) become a tiny inline delta on the section root, never a whole theme.

Derived semantic colour aliases from palette + `primaryShade {light, dark}` (`getCSSColorVariables`) -> design_system token compiler: author only 10-shade palettes and a shade index; compiler emits `--ds-color-primary-filled/-hover/-subtle/-outline/-text` deterministically.

`luminance.ts` + `getContrastColor` -> design_system compiler AND qa_gate: compute on-colour text at compile time, but replace the luminance threshold with a WCAG 2.x contrast-ratio check (>= 4.5) and fail the build (not the runtime) when a palette shade cannot host readable text.
`virtualColor` -> design_system: a scheme-dependent alias token (`surface`, `accent`) resolving to different palettes for light/dark without consumers knowing.
`ColorSchemeScript` inline pre-paint script (framework-free, ~10 lines) -> renderer `<head>` partial for FOUC-free colour scheme; `useProviderColorScheme` matchMedia sync -> a 1 kB vanilla island.

`createVarsResolver` per component + CSS module with `var(--x, fallback)` -> section library: each section variant/arrangement declares a typed `vars` contract (e.g. `--section-density`, `--focal-weight`) resolved from `composition` fields in deterministic TS, consumed by static CSS.

`:where()` zero-specificity selectors + `data-*` modifiers (`mod` -> `getBoxMod`) + `@layer` output (`generate-css.ts`) -> renderer CSS conventions so art_direction and design_system layers can override section CSS predictably.
`scale` token + `rem()` = `calc(Xrem * var(--scale))` + PostCSS autoRem -> design_system: one `--ds-scale` var for density presets (compact/comfortable/editorial) without regenerating tokens.

`use-focus-trap` (`tabbable.ts`, `scope-tab.ts`), `use-scroll-into-view` easing/cancel logic, `use-in-viewport` -> motion/islands: port as framework-free TS utilities for the <=1 interactive island per section (mobile nav, dialog, in-view reveal), all respecting `prefers-reduced-motion` like `useScrollIntoView` does.
patterns_to_avoid: Adopting `@mantine/core` components in Astro islands -> requires React 19 runtime + `MantineProvider` context + mandatory global CSS (baseline/default-css-variables/global) per island; blows the 180 kB JS budget and the near-zero-JS rule, and drags in @floating-ui/react and react-remove-scroll.

Runtime theme injection via `<style dangerouslySetInnerHTML>` (`MantineCssVariables`) and per-Box `InlineStyles` for responsive props -> our pages are static; all tokens and responsive CSS must be emitted at build time so Lighthouse CI budgets and the anti-slop/QA gates see the final CSS.

Style props system (`m`, `p`, `bg`, `fz`... on every element) -> invites ad-hoc per-element values that bypass the token contract; our model selects ids, never emits tokens, so sections must consume only named vars.

`theme.other: any` / `components: any` escape hatches and function-valued theme fields (`variantColorResolver`) -> our design systems must be pure JSON validated by Zod so they can be versioned, diffed and selected by id.
Luminance-threshold contrast (0.3) as the accessibility decision -> not a WCAG ratio; our qa_gate uses axe-core; the compiler should use a real contrast ratio and hard-fail.

Generic xs..xl size scale and system-font dashboard aesthetic as the token vocabulary -> our design systems need `visual_dna` (type scale ratios, rhythm, texture, depth) that Mantine's theme shape cannot express; do not inherit its token taxonomy wholesale.
Hashed CSS-module class names (`hash-css-selector`) -> brittle targets for the post-V1 visual editor and for Playwright QA selectors; prefer stable `data-section`/`data-variant` attributes.
reusable_patterns: TokenResolverCompiler: a pure function `(typedTheme) -> {shared, light, dark}` CSS-variable maps, serialised to scoped selectors, run at build time for defaults and diffed at runtime/pagetime for overrides.
DerivedSemanticAliases: raw N-shade palettes + a per-scheme primary shade index generate all semantic role variables (filled/hover/subtle/outline/text) deterministically.
VirtualColorToken: a token name whose value is `var(--name-i)` and resolves to different palettes per colour scheme.
ComputedContrastForeground: compile-time luminance/contrast computation selecting foreground colour and stored as a variable, never decided in the browser.

ComponentVarsContract: each component/section declares a typed set of CSS variables, resolved from props by a pure resolver and consumed by static CSS with `var(--x, fallback)`; instance overrides never touch selectors.
PrePaintSchemeScript: an inline `<head>` script sets a `data-color-scheme` attribute from storage/matchMedia before first paint; all scheme-dependent vars hang off that attribute.
ScaleVariable: every rem value is `calc(Xrem * var(--scale))` so global density is one variable.
adoption_strategy: Adapt - do not install @mantine/core (React runtime, provider requirement, 39 kB gz global CSS and a dashboard token vocabulary all conflict with Astro islands, the 180 kB JS budget and design-systems-as-JSON). Port the pattern: write a ~200-line TS `compileDesignSystem(tokens.json) -> tokens.css` modelled on `default-css-variables-resolver.ts` + `convert-css-variables.ts`, including derived semantic colour aliases from palette + primaryShade, virtual (scheme-dependent) tokens, compile-time contrast computation (upgraded to a WCAG ratio check that fails the build), and the `--scale` multiplier; snapshot-test its output per design_system_id. Adopt the CSS conventions (`:where()`, `data-*` modifiers, `@layer`, per-component vars with fallbacks) for the section library, and copy the framework-free pieces verbatim: the ColorSchemeScript inline script and the focus-trap/tabbable, scroll-into-view and in-viewport logic from @mantine/hooks as vanilla TS for islands.
